our story

# HeartLegacy is now SalesMail!

Same team, same service, now under one unified brand.

[learn more about our brand consolidation](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/heartlegacy-rebrands-to-salesmail-in-strategic-move-to-create-a-unified-brand-and-strengthen-market-leadership-302653437.html?)

We are obsessed with delivering world-class service to our business partners, empowering them to build strong relationships and create memorable experiences with the audiences that matter most to them.

![Group portrait of 27 people wearing matching blue t-shirts with a green logo, posed indoors in front of wooden doors.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6978f255c49bba7e66007dea_AKO%202026%20Team%20Pic%20Web.png)

## Our promise

SalesMail helps organizations make every prospect, customer, resident, or guest feel seen, valued, and connected.

![UI Icon Point RG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e351887cee7190fece5b_ui-icon-point-rg.svg)

### Simple to use.

We believe in the elegance of simplicity. Our company's core mission is to remove friction from your workflow, designing every solution to be an intuitive extension of your team.

![UI Icon Rocket RG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e351b9d0ecf09db4fed7_ui-icon-rocket-rg.svg)

### Powerful in impact.

Our obsession is your measurable success. We empower partners to build stronger relationships and create memorable experiences, proving our value through your growth.

![UI Icon User Add RG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e3510474aa9b474d5f7a_ui-icon-user-add-rg.svg)

### Backed by a team.

Backed by a team that cares as much about your success as you do. When communication feels human again, results follow.
